fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY)'s next-generation obesity drug EloraTZP demonstrated average weight loss of 54.1 pounds over 48 weeks and achievement of normal blood sugar levels in up to 77%, with the stock expected to rise 25% in 2026.
fields.summary_ko.1: LLY's first-line drugs (Mounjaro, Zepbound) hold approximately 61% of the U.S. market, and the forward P/E of 40.36x represents a 12% discount versus the 5-year average of 45.73x.
